222-527-2079-8249.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-2079-8249.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Defiant Salvager twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

1322-1456-5078-8171.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Vraska triggers, creating a 1/1 Sculpture Treasure artifact creature token.
Activate the token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

5078-6766-7175-8171.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Vraska triggers, creating a 1/1 Sculpture Treasure artifact creature token.
Activate the token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

813-2081-2171.description:
Cast Culling the Weak by paying {B} and sacrificing Scholar of the Ages, adding {B}{B}{B}{B}.
Cast Persist by paying its mana cost, returning Scholar of the Ages from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Scholar of the Ages enters, it triggers, returning Culling the Weak and Persist from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1809-5531-5694-6664-8110.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {2}{C}{C}.
1809-5531-5694-6664-8110.description:
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{C}{C}.
Cast Eldrazi Confluence by paying {2}{C}{C}, selecting its second mode three times, blinking Lumra, Returned Pastcaller and Famished Worldsire.
As Famished Worldsire enters, choose to sacrifice at least the lands tapped for mana in step 1, causing Famished Worldsire to then enter with three +1/+1 counters for each land sacrificed.
When Lumra, Returned Pastcaller and Famished Worldsire enter, they each trigger.
Resolve the Lumra trigger, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to The Wandering Minstrel.
Resolve the Returned Pastcaller trigger, returning Eldrazi Confluence from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Famished Worldsire trigger, causing you to look at some cards from the top of your library and put any land cards from among them onto the battlefield untapped due to The Wandering Minstrel.
Repeat.
1809-5531-5694-6664-8110.notes: If you can generate infinite {C} once you have all the lands on the battlefield, you can forego blinking Lumra and Famished Worldsire, and instead elect to blink Returned Pastcaller and choose any two other modes from Eldrazi Confluence. This can allow you to blink other creatures, create infinite Eldrazi Spawn tokens and/or reduce any number of creatures' toughness to 0.

1168-1479-2841-8100.easyPrerequisites:
(optional)You control an Elf or have an Elf card in hand. Your life total is 2 or higher.
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Elven Passage.
1168-1479-2841-8100.description:
Fetch a land using Elven Passage.
When the fetched land enters, Toggo and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Toggo trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Toggo trigger from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Toggo triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

1479-2443-2841-2907.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Evolving Wilds.
1479-2443-2841-2907.description:
Fetch a land using Evolving Wilds.
When the fetched land enters, Scute Swarm and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Scute Swarm trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Scute Swarm from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Scute Swarm triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

4247-4396-4871-5220.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
4247-4396-4871-5220.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing the nontoken creature.
When the creature dies, Mortuary and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying its mana cost
Repeat.

654-4772-6441-6753-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Amulet of Vigor triggers eight times, untapping the New Planets.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

275-5078-7729.description:
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {1}
The Vision and Scarlet Witch triggers, adding {R} and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Transplant Theorist triggers.
Holding priority, activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Resolve the Transplant Theorist trigger, causing you to draw Sensei's Divining Top from your library, and then discard a card other than Sensei's Divining Top.
Repeat

1999-4613-7340-7434.easyPrerequisites: Master Transmuter does not have summoning sickness.
1999-4613-7340-7434.description:
Activate Brass Infiniscope by tapping it, adding at least two mana which you can spend to activate Master Transmuter due to Agatha's Soul Cauldron.
Activate Master Transmuter by paying {U}, tapping it, and returning Brass Infiniscope from the battlefield to your hand, putting Sewer-veillance Cam from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Sewer-veillance Cam enters, it triggers, allowing you to untap Master Transmuter.
Activate Master Transmuter by paying {U}, tapping it, and returning Sewer-veillance Cam from the battlefield to your hand, putting Brass Infiniscope from your hand onto the vattlefield.
When Sewer-veillance Cam leaves the battlefield, it triggers, allowing you to untap Master Transmuter.
Repeat.
1999-4613-7340-7434.notes: Each activation of Brass Infiniscope adds a delayed triggered ability that can draw you cards and gain life if you cast a spell with {X} in its cost. If you wish to use these abilities, you'll want to stop the combo before getting too many triggers such that you'll deck yourself and lose the game. To gain life, you must spend at least {2} for X when casting the spell.

282-1479-3257.description:
Create a nonlegendary copy of Kodama of the East Tree using Delina (this may involve additional steps depending on the card used).
Play Rakdos Carnarium.
When Rakdos Carnarium enters, both Kodama of the East Trees and Rakdos Carnarium trigger.
Resolve the nonlegendary Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Rakdos Carnarium trigger, returning it to your hand.
Resolve the legendary Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting Rakdos Carnarium onto the battlefield.
The nonlegendary Kodama of the East Tree and Rakdos Carnarium trigger.
Resolve the Rakdos Carnarium trigger, returning it to your hand.
Resolve the nonlegendary Kodama of the East Tree's trigger, putting Rakdos Carnarium onto the battlefield.
The legendary Kodama of the East Tree and Rakdos Carnarium trigger.
Repeat from step 5.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more counters on it

243-2092-4050-7218.description:
Activate Reaping Willow by paying {W/B} due to Agatha of the Vile Cauldron and removing two counters from it, returning Plague Belcher from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Plague Belcher enters, it triggers, putting two -1/-1 counters on Reaping Willow.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Plague Belcher, adding {W/B}.
Repeat.

2060-4116-5636-5660.easyPrerequisites: There are at least four permanent cards between your hand and graveyard.
2060-4116-5636-5660.notablePrerequisites: You have at least four cards in hand.
2060-4116-5636-5660.description:
Activate Volrath by paying {1}, causing it to become a copy of Psychic Frog until your next turn.
Activate Volrath using Psychic Frog's ability four times by discarding four cards.
Holding priority, activate Volrath by paying {1}, causing it to become a copy of Evolution Witness until your next turn.
Resolve the first Volrath ability from step 2, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Volrath triggers, returning a permanent card from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat steps 4 and 5 for each remaining ability.
Activate Volrath by paying {1}, causing it to become a copy of Crystalline Crawler until end of turn.
Activate Volrath using Crystalline Crawler's ability three times by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {3}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2012-4050-6972.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Strangleroot Geist
When Strangleroot Geist dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Strangleroot Geist
When Strangleroot Geist dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Strangleroot Geist enters and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness. Its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat from step 3.
2012-4050-6972.notes: If Strangleroot Geist starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 3 instead.

3933-4929-5479-7267.notablePrerequisites:
Lost Jitte has at least one charge counter on it.
Cryptic Trilobite has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
3933-4929-5479-7267.description:
Activate Karn's Bastion by paying {4}, putting a charge counter on Lost Jitte and two +1/+1 counters on Cryptic Trilobite.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite's first ability twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {C}{C}{C}{C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Activate Lost Jitte by removing a charge counter from it, untapping Karn's Bastion.
Repeat.

2034-4446-4681-5170.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Cleric
2034-4446-4681-5170.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, Relic Vial triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Relic Vial trigger.
Resolve the Relic Vial trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

5147-6754-7084.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Eusocial Engineering triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

261-338-3490-4050.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
261-338-3490-4050.description:
Gain life.
The creature with Light of Promise attached triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Suture Priest triggers, causing you to gain life.
The creature with Light of Promise attached triggers. Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {1}.
Resolve the trigger from the creature with Light of Promise attached, putting a +1/+1 counter on it 
Repeat from step 3.

997-2866-3518-4986.description:
Cast Lion's Eye Diamond by paying its mana cost.
Teshar triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Lion's Eye Diamond by discarding your hand and sacrificing it.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Scrap Trawler.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Lion's Eye Diamond from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

413-586-5258-5618-6747.notablePrerequisites: You control at least X artifacts.
413-586-5258-5618-6747.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying at most {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it and Blasting Station trigger, adding {B}{B}{B} and untapping Blasting Station.
Repeat.

1548-3719-4050-6307--85.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least six creatures, excluding Port Razer, that have total power 1 or greater.
An opponent cannot block and kill Port Razer or Luxurious Locomotive.
There are at least four card types among cards in your graveyard.
1548-3719-4050-6307--85.description:
Activate Luxurious Locomotive's crew ability by tapping six creatures you control with total power 1 or greater, causing Luxurious Locomotive to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Declare Luxurious Locomotive and Port Raazer as attackers, triggering Luxurious Locomotive, creating at least six Treasure tokens.
Deal combat damage using Port Razer, triggering its ability.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Port Razer, adding {1}.
Resolve the Port Razer ability, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Ruthless Technomancer by paying {2}{B} and sacrificing four Treasures, returning Port Razer from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2 each combat phase.

225-5412-5531-5702.easyPrerequisites:
You have at least two lands between the battlefield and your graveyard.
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
You control a land that can tap to produce at least {G}.
225-5412-5531-5702.description:
Play any land.
When the land enters the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko triggers.
Holding priority, activate Coastal Hornclaw by sacrificing a land.
Repeat step 3 until you control no lands.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Lumra.
Put the token Lumra into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Lumra token's enter-the-battlefield ability triggers, causing you to mill four cards and returning all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko and Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger that many times.
Resolve a Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping a land.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding at least {G}.
Repeat from step 9 for each remaining Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger.
Resolve all but one Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating that many 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Repeat from step 3.

1909-4486-6479.notablePrerequisites: Rainveil Rejuvenator has its power boosted by at least 1.
1909-4486-6479.description:
Activate Rainveil Rejuvenator by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}.
Cast Wirewood Symbiote by paying {G}.
Activate Mirror Entity by paying {1}, giving creatures you control all creature types and base power and toughness 1/1 until end of turn.
Activate Wirewood Symbiote by returning it from the battlefield to your hand, untapping Rainveil Rejuvenator.
Repeat.
1909-4486-6479.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may activate Mirror Entity to make your creatures infinitely large until end of turn.

1429-2511-5958.notablePrerequisites: Lesser Masticore does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
1429-2511-5958.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Lesser Masticore.
When Lesser Masticore dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Curator Beastie.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

437-509-2392-2751-4131.manaNeeded: {3}{U}{R} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
437-509-2392-2751-4131.notablePrerequisites: Silverskin Armor attached to Sphinx's Disciple.
437-509-2392-2751-4131.description:
Cast Idris either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {1}{U}{R} and commander tax, if applicable.
When Idris enters the battlefield, its imprint ability triggers, targeting Sphinx's Disciple.
Holding priority, activate Strionic Resonator by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Idris' trigger, targeting Basalt Monolith.
Resolve both Idris triggers, exiling Basalt Monolith and Sphinx's Disciple.
During your next turn, activate Idris using Basalt Monolith's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Idris using Basalt Monolith's second ability by paying {3}, untapping it.
Sphinx's Disciple triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 5.

2292-3394-4191-5010.notablePrerequisites: Weatherlight Compleated has at least six phyresis counters on it.
2292-3394-4191-5010.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Golgari Thug.
When Golgari Thug dies, it and Weatherlight Compleated trigger.
Resolve the Golgari Thug trigger, putting it on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Weatherlight Compleated trigger, putting a phyresis counter on it and causing you to draw Golgari Thug from the top of your library.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability from step 1, causing you to scry 1.
Cast Golgari Thug by paying {0} due to Aluren.
Repeat.

129-1409-1414-5131.notablePrerequisites: Deadeye Navigator is paired with Muldrotha.
129-1409-1414-5131.description:
Activate Lotus Petal by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Kinnan triggers, adding {U}.
Activate Muldrotha by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Muldrotha enters the battlefield, Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability triggers, repairing it and Muldrotha.
Cast Lotus Petal from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Repeat.

1692-2743-3094-5277.notablePrerequisites:
Helm of the Host attached to Biovisionary.
Abstruse Archaic does not have summoning sickness.
1692-2743-3094-5277.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Helm of the Host triggers.
Holding priority, activate Lithoform Engine's first ability by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Helm of the Host's trigger.
Activate Abstruse Archaic by paying {1} and tapping it, copying Helm of the Host's trigger.
Resolve all Helm of the Host triggers, creating three token copies of Biovisionary with haste.
At the beginning of your end step, each Biovisionary triggers.
Resolve the first trigger, causing you to win the game.

2433-3490-4050.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
You control at least one additional creature.
2433-3490-4050.description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Rosie triggers, targeting any creature except the Servo.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {1}.
Resolve the Rosie ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on the targeted creature.
Repeat from step 2.

606-1162-5313.notablePrerequisites:
Your life total is a multiple of 3.
You control another transforming double-faced card that is an artifact or creature on its front face.
606-1162-5313.description:
Activate Treasonous Ogre by paying three life, adding {R}.
Repeat until your life total is equal to three.
Cast True Polymorph by paying {4}{U}{U}, causing any transforming double-faced creature or artifact you control to become a copy of Enduring Angel.
Activate Treasonous Ogre by paying three life, adding {R}.
The copy of Enduring Angel causes your life total to become three, and transforms, but stays a copy of Enduring Angel.
Repeat from step 4.

628-855-2034-2122.notablePrerequisites: Mindless Automaton has an even number of +1/+1 counters on it.
628-855-2034-2122.description:
Activate Mindless Automaton's second ability by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat step 1 until Mindless Automaton has zero +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Mindless Automaton, adding {C}{C}.
Mindless Automaton dies, triggering its undying ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a total of six +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat.

1030-1636-4659-4840.notablePrerequisites: Othelm does not have summoning sickness.
1030-1636-4659-4840.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Myr Battlesphere, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Othelm by paying {2} and tapping it, returning Myr Battlesphere from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Myr Battlesphere enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Intruder Alarm.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Resolve the Myr Battlesphere trigger, creating four 1/1 Myr artifact creature tokens.
The Myr tokens enter the battlefield, triggering Intruder Alarm four times, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

2719-3846-3851.notablePrerequisites:
Atemsis does not have summoning sickness.
Blade of Selves attached to Atemsis.
Opponents can not block and kill creatures you control.
You have at least six cards in hand with different mana values.
2719-3846-3851.description:
Declare Atemsis as an attacker.
Atemsis' myriad ability triggers, creating a token copy of Atemsis tapped and attacking each other opponent.
Deal combat damage using each Atemsis, triggering their abilities.
Resolve each Atemsis trigger, causing you to reveal your hand and causing each opponent to lose the game.

864-2596-4050.notablePrerequisites: You have at least four additional creature cards in your graveyard and/or on the battlefield.
864-2596-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Eternal Witness and all other creatures you control, adding {B} for each creature sacrificed.
Cast Living Death by paying {3}{B}{B}, causing each player to exile all creatures from their graveyard, sacrifice all creatures they control, then return the exiled cards to the battlefield.
When Eternal Witness enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Living Death from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat any number of times.

1309-1987-2510-5116.notablePrerequisites: Any instant exiled by Semblance Anvil.
1309-1987-2510-5116.description:
Activate Gilded Lotus by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Gilded Lotus and Salvager of Secrets, blinking them.
When Salvager of Secrets enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
Repeat.
